scope: Required application/release cases. All delivered cases NOT_RUN; helper tests are separate.

cases.title: Correct repository and live baseline
cases.expected: Actual clean or safely reconciled PikkuJanne/WinBookSplit checkout/branch/origin identified; no reset/stash/deletion of owner work.

cases.title: Previous releases snapshot
cases.expected: Both v1.0.0/v1.0.1 peeled tag targets and public asset identity snapshots recorded; fresh observations distinguished from BASELINE.json.

cases.title: 3.15 current policy reproduction
cases.expected: Existing policy rejects regular stable 3.15.0 as unsupported minor; reproduction is recorded without claiming PDF execution occurred.

cases.title: Unsigned setup negative reproduction
cases.expected: Owned Internet-marked setup script fails direct invocation in a process-only RemoteSigned context before a setup marker; actual policy recorded.

cases.title: Active instructions consistent
cases.expected: Root/nested active routing, authority and completion point to v1.0.2; prior safety rules remain; no contradictory active old version gates.

cases.title: Focused implementation/evidence map
cases.expected: Existing evaluator/setup/native/packaging integration points and minimal-human strategy identified; no new rewrite/test platform planned.

cases.title: Reviewed 3.15 policy entry
cases.expected: Regular stable 3.15.0 is accepted by the shipped shared evaluator with actual upstream review; an authentic new blocker is not silently converted into optional support.

cases.title: Later stable patches
cases.expected: 3.15.1 and synthetic 3.15.99 are numerically accepted; no exact 3.15.0 gate; fixture-only versions not claimed as installed/tested binaries.

cases.title: Retained serviced branches
cases.expected: Existing 3.13.16/3.14.8 floors and later patches accepted; 3.14.2 remains appropriately below floor unless a documented reviewed change supersedes it.

cases.title: Truthful unknown-minor reason
cases.expected: An unlisted minor is unsupported/not validated, not automatically insecure; prerelease/architecture/build checks stay distinct.

cases.title: Strict shared policy integrity
cases.expected: Malformed/duplicate/inconsistent policy records, missing sources and identity mismatches are rejected; setup/preflight/docs/tests reference the same policy.

cases.title: Future patch comparison and preference
cases.expected: Version comparisons handle multi-digit patches numerically; automatic preference favors accepted 3.15 over 3.14/3.13 without requiring runtime network lookup.

cases.title: Real 3.15 interpreter evidence
cases.expected: Official regular GIL x64 CPython 3.15.0 actually executes tests; observed version/identity/path recorded, no fallback interpreter substituted.

cases.title: Runtime-only package setup
cases.expected: 3.15 creates application-local venv, installs the reviewed hash-locked pypdf and validates origin; no global packages or dev fixtures/renderers required.

cases.title: PDF engine integration
cases.expected: Actual 3.15 manual/Level1/Level2 splitting and shared preview plan pass with correct coverage/page order and source immutability.

cases.title: Document safety regression
cases.expected: Encrypted/unsupported-active-PDF rejection and existing reader guard tests pass under 3.15; no safeguard removed for compatibility.

cases.title: Process and protocol integration
cases.expected: Real isolated 3.15 probes/process helpers drain streams, handle Unicode, cancellation/deadlines and meaningful outcomes without deadlock or false success.

cases.title: Dev tooling separation
cases.expected: Missing cp315 developer wheels cannot masquerade as runtime incompatibility; any per-minor test tooling changes preserve verified dependency hashes and fixture provenance.

cases.title: 3.15-only automatic discovery
cases.expected: Without override/venv, trusted regular 3.15 is discovered and selected automatically; installation is never triggered during processing discovery.

cases.title: Broken optional launcher fallback
cases.expected: A legacy/manager py listing failure like Unknown option -0 is recorded but a valid direct 3.15 candidate still succeeds.

cases.title: Authoritative existing environment
cases.expected: Healthy accepted 3.13/3.14 venv remains selected despite PATH 3.15; identity/diagnostics name it accurately; setup is a no-change no-op.

cases.title: Stale environment preserved
cases.expected: Rejected/broken .venv remains authoritative and is not deleted or silently bypassed; failure names the actual venv version and specific reason.

cases.title: Explicit repair to 3.15
cases.expected: Valid 3.15 base plus Repair creates working new venv while retaining a unique old backup; rollback/error behavior is honest and non-destructive.

cases.title: Trust and override preservation
cases.expected: Invalid explicit selection, shadow modules, unsafe aliases/CWD sources and untrusted package origin fail as before; no any-python fallback or auto-download.

cases.title: Sibling script and trusted host
cases.expected: Setup BAT invokes sibling setup via trusted Windows PowerShell executable using NoProfile/process-only policy/File, independent of PATH/CWD.

cases.title: Argument forwarding
cases.expected: NonInteractive, Check, Repair, PythonPath and Wheelhouse reach setup accurately with quoted paths; hostile punctuation cannot become another command.

cases.title: Unattended and interactive behavior
cases.expected: Unattended setup never reads/pauses; interactive no-argument setup presents useful result without creating another installation path.

cases.title: Exit fidelity
cases.expected: Child setup exit 0/3/6/130 and host launch/binding failures remain correct nonzero/zero outcomes through BAT; no last echo/pause masks them.

cases.title: Unrelated directory and shell hosts
cases.expected: BAT works from System32/unrelated directory and PS5.1/PS7/CMD for supported path/argument cases; missing sibling/invalid options fail safely.

cases.title: Policy/security boundaries
cases.expected: No global policy, ADS stripping, elevation, settings mutation or enterprise-control bypass; enforced organization denial remains a failure with retained native output.

cases.title: No bare unsigned default remedy
cases.expected: All active generated setup remedies use BAT or a full policy-scoped host invocation; no bare direct unsigned ps1 Action remains.

cases.title: Correct observed identity
cases.expected: Console and structured diagnostics identify actual selected interpreter/version/source even when python --version reports a different PATH interpreter.

cases.title: Distinct actionable reasons
cases.expected: Security floor, unknown minor, prerelease/build/architecture, missing/wrong/origin-invalid pypdf and pre-script policy failure are not conflated.

cases.title: Fresh setup remedy round-trip
cases.expected: Exact action emitted for 3.15-only missing-pypdf state executes from a RemoteSigned PowerShell parent with marked scripts, then the original split succeeds.

cases.title: Repair remedy round-trip
cases.expected: Exact stale-venv repair action selects a valid discovered 3.15 base, preserves backup, and restores application readiness without manual file deletion.

cases.title: Quoting and privacy
cases.expected: Generated actions preserve spaces/apostrophes/Unicode and shell semantics; local raw diagnostics stay private, redacted reports do not leak user paths or secrets.

cases.title: Verified Internet marks
cases.expected: ADS ZoneId=3 is present on actual extracted .ps1/helper files before and after positive tests; unsupported filesystem setup cannot count as pass.

cases.title: Negative control proves the incident
cases.expected: Direct unsigned script invocation fails before setup under process RemoteSigned; failure and absent setup marker recorded.

cases.title: New BAT works on marked files
cases.expected: Actual setup BAT launches marked setup, creates usable 3.15 environment and permits PDF processing with no Unblock-File or persistent setting change.

cases.title: Generated host remedy works
cases.expected: Full suggested host action also succeeds from PS5.1/PS7 RemoteSigned parents with real marked setup helpers and preserved return codes.

cases.title: Policies remain unchanged
cases.expected: Parent Process and persistent/organization scope observations before/after match; only the owned child Process policy differs intentionally.

cases.title: Organization denial not evaded
cases.expected: Blocked/missing-script/host-failure paths retain meaningful nonzero errors; no alternative encoded/evaluated route circumvents enforced signing; mocks are labeled simulation.

cases.title: Required CI matrix
cases.expected: Actual 3.15.0 runs in required source CI alongside reviewed legacy branches; no continue-on-error/conditional skip converting absence into success.

cases.title: Existing suite retained
cases.expected: Full applicable existing regression suite runs; old safety tests remain; changed behavior assertions are individually reviewed rather than removed.

cases.title: Secure test pipeline
cases.expected: Verified action pins, bounded jobs, least privilege, isolated hashed dependencies and only authored/redacted artifacts; no personal documents or credentials uploaded.

cases.title: Kit uses exact candidate and runtime
cases.expected: Existing native kit extended, records ZIP/member/hash identity and actual 3.15 executable; does not fake runtime selection or alter owner installation.

cases.title: One consolidated owner action
cases.expected: When native10 access is unavailable, a self-contained validated command/report kit handles setup/tests/report collection without manual version matching or chapter checks.

cases.title: Truthful kit/environment reports
cases.expected: OS caption/build distinguishes native Windows10/11 from Server CI; simulations, USER_LAUNCHED_AUTOMATED and missing checks remain explicitly labeled.

cases.title: One current application version
cases.expected: VERSION, runtime banners, active docs/help/metadata and intended release names are 1.0.2; old historical reports/releases unchanged.

cases.title: Consistent primary setup instructions
cases.expected: README/help/SETUP/errors/release draft all give tested BAT or process-host remedies; explained shell and repair paths agree.

cases.title: Accurate support boundaries
cases.expected: 3.15 and serviced 3.13/3.14 targets, same-branch numeric patches and unknown-minor distinctions documented without broad untested compatibility promises.

cases.title: Complete release inventory
cases.expected: New Setup BAT and shared helper/policy files appear in allowlist, manifest, source hashes and tests; extracted package has everything needed.

cases.title: Clean distribution and source distinction
cases.expected: Runtime ZIP excludes venv/dev dependencies/private logs/kit runtimes/handoff clutter; GitHub source ZIP is not presented as accepted release asset.

cases.title: Honest limits and examples
cases.expected: Unsigned/policy and Windows10 servicing notices retained; actual quick-start/check/repair/offline examples exercised; no silent requirement to downgrade 3.15.

cases.title: Reviewed bounded change
cases.expected: Review confirms incremental 3.15/setup/diagnostic fix, no protection weakening or unrelated rewrite; material findings resolved or blocking.

cases.title: Final source regression and CI
cases.expected: Required actual tests and CI pass on reviewed R; no failures/skips hidden; diagnostics/action/MOTW cases present in evidence.

cases.title: Source freeze and synchronization
cases.expected: Clean committed R is in intended reviewed branch/main history and freshly synchronized; unpublished v1.0.2 collision checked.

cases.title: Exact assets built
cases.expected: Versioned ZIP, release-manifest.json and SHA256SUMS.txt built from R with reviewed tooling/dependencies; hashes/sizes recorded.

cases.title: Independent package verification
cases.expected: Actual archive member names/bytes/version/new BAT/source/dependency data independently match source/manifest; no duplicate/traversal/private material.

cases.title: Candidate identity stable
cases.expected: One frozen ZIP Z bound to R and native test kit; later runtime/package changes require updated evidence instead of hand-edited hashes.

cases.title: Windows10 real 3.15 final ZIP
cases.expected: Native Windows10 22H2 x64/inbox PS5.1 executes candidate Z setup/selected-runtime/PDF suite using actual 3.15.0, not Server simulation.

cases.title: Windows11 real 3.15 final ZIP
cases.expected: Native Windows11 x64/inbox PS5.1 runs same Z with real 3.15.0 and targeted setup/PDF/MOTW checks.

cases.title: Final-asset launch and remedy gates
cases.expected: New setup BAT plus exact emitted action work with actual marked Z scripts under process RemoteSigned; negative control, exit/status and immutable source checks captured.

cases.title: Real ebook integration under 3.15
cases.expected: Representative authored EPUB and genuine unencrypted AZW3 convert and split under 3.15 using locked Calibre; original and output validation recorded.

cases.title: Existing branches and PS7 preserved
cases.expected: Focused same-Z setup/check/PDF smoke on accepted 3.13 and 3.14 plus reviewed PS7 3.15 invocation passes; tested combinations reported exactly.

cases.title: Evidence and human scope correct
cases.expected: Reports bind R/Z/runtime/machine/commands/results; mandatory failures absent; human work limited to one consolidated kit run only if needed, not fake agent/GUI claims.

cases.title: All gates pass before publication
cases.expected: Prior tasks and named release gates have real required evidence; Python3.15/native/marked-setup scope is not waived or silently removed.

cases.title: Fixed correct tag/source
cases.expected: Live peeled v1.0.2 tag equals accepted R; no retag/clobber of an existing conflicting tag and no old-release modification.

cases.title: Public intended release
cases.expected: v1.0.2 is public non-draft non-prerelease with the exact accepted ZIP/manifest/checksum assets and truthful tested-support/unsigned notes.

cases.title: Anonymous assets match
cases.expected: Fresh unauthenticated downloads match accepted sizes/hashes and archive/member/version/manifest R; authenticated draft availability not substituted.

cases.title: Old releases preserved
cases.expected: v1.0.0 and v1.0.1 peeled refs and stable asset identities compare unchanged against initial snapshots; volatile download counts excluded.

cases.title: Closure and live main synchronized
cases.expected: Final clean local main equals fresh remote main; any closure commit is docs-only with R/package members unchanged; final user report includes public URL, R, hashes and actual test scope.
